description: A small fridge is in front with a few fruits on the counter: a yellow mango-like fruit, a small red berry, a dark plum, and a banana near the right side. The right hand reaches to the fridge handle and pulls the door open toward the viewer while the left hand stays braced on the counter; then the right hand picks up the fruits one by one and places them onto the fridge shelves (first the yellow fruit and red berry down low, the dark plum up higher, and the banana across the middle shelf) before pushing the door closed with the right hand.
